automaticAuthorities.binding: per-run freshAgentId, model, reasoningEffort, forkTurns, singleShot, timestamps, and exact runtime preamble
immutable baseline commit, Git tree, Git object path, and content digest
logical identity, resolved path, and content digest

invocationPolicy.control: Use only automatic authorities and the exact scenario prompt.
invocationPolicy.candidate: Use automatic authorities plus the candidate AGENTS.md and four declared repository skills.
invocationPolicy.repositoryFileReading: prohibited except for declared candidate inputs

captureBoundary: Platform policy text is not copied into repository artifacts. Its application is bound to the fresh agent identity and execution configuration; every behavior-specific runtime instruction is preserved verbatim in the per-run preamble artifact.
